titulo_es: The most: superlative and quantity comparisons

крупнейший.es: el más grande (de tamaño); el mayor

столько же.en: the same amount; as many / as many as

величайший.es: el más grande o destacado (superlativo de великий)
величайший.en: the largest or most outstanding (superlative of великий)

всех.es: de todos; genitivo plural de все
всех.en: of all; genitive plural of все

нас.en: of us; the genius of мы

texto: A very common form of the superlative is **самый** + adjective: **самый красивый** (the most beautiful), **самая интересная** (the most interesting), **самое дорогое** (the most expensive), **самые большие** (the largest). **Самый** and the adjective match the noun in gender, number and case.

There are also forms of a word, such as **крупнейший** (the largest, size), **величайший** (the largest or most prominent) and **наименьший** (the smallest; the minimum). They are learned along with each adjective.
With a comparative + **всех** (of all) «the / the most»: **Он старше всех** is expressed (is the largest of all).
«from» is used to say **из** + genitive: **самый умный из нас** (the smartest of us).
«as many / as many as» uses **столько же, сколько**; after **столько** the noun usually goes in plural genitive: **У меня столько же книг, сколько у тебя** (I have as many books as you).

filas: столько же книг, сколько у тебя

frases.ru: Кто самый умный в вашем классе?
frases.es: ¿Quién es el más listo de vuestra clase?
frases.en: Who's the smartest in your class?

frases.ru: Анна самая умная. Она старше всех и умнее всех.
frases.es: Anna es la más lista. Es la mayor de todos y la más lista de todos.
frases.en: Anna's the smartest. She's the biggest of all and the smartest of all.
analisis: the largest of all (всех = of all, genitive)

frases.es: Sí, es la mejor de todos.
frases.en: Yeah, she's the best of all.

frases.es: Ella es la más amable de nosotros.
analisis: the most kind of us (иш + genitive)

bloques.titulo: Vocabulary: the most, the best and from

opciones.explicacion: **самая** = the most (feminine): it matches **красивая**.
**самый** is masculine: it does not match «the».
**самое** is neutral: it is not feminine.
**старше всех** = the largest of all.
The minor is **младший**.

opciones.texto: He's more handsome than all of us.
opciones.explicacion: That would be **красивее всех**: «The most handsome of all».
**самое** is neutral: it matches **дорогое**.
**самый** is masculine: it does not match **дорогое**.
**самая** is feminine: it does not match **дорогое**.
It's the one that says the phrase.
It's not what the phrase says.
It's not what the phrase says.

opciones.texto: the / the largest or most outstanding
opciones.explicacion: **величайший** expresses the maximum **великий**: «the / the largest» or «the most outstanding».
The smallest is **наименьший**.
The minor is **младший**.

bloques.pregunta: Complete «as many as» with the structure столько же..., сколько.
bloques.frase: У меня ___ книг, сколько у тебя.

opciones.explicacion: **столько же ..., сколько** = as many / as many as; **книг** is plural genitive.
**сколько** means «how many» and here it appears after the coma.
**больше** means «more»; it does not form the «as many as» structure.
**старший** indicates age or relative position: greater than others.
The minor is **младший**.
The highest is **самый высокий**.

intro: Today you learn a common way of saying «the / the most», other forms of superlative, «the / the largest of all» and how to compare quantities: as many as or between several.
